{{recipe}}

This '''quince pudding''' recipe originates from the 1881 ''Household Cyclopedia''.

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Quince|Quinces]]
* [[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]]
* Ground [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* Ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]]

== Procedure ==

# Scald quinces until tender.
#Skin them and scrape the pulp into a [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]].
#[[Cookbook:Puréeing|Blend]] the pulp with sugar until very sweet. Add ginger and cinnamon to taste.
#Combine the cream and eggs. Stir this into the quince pulp until thick.
#Butter a pudding-pan or other [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]]. Pour in the quince-cream mixture.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] until firm but still slightly wobbly in the centre. Remove from oven and leave till set.
